name: gizza-ai/change-speed
summary: Speed up or slow down a video.

tool.description: Speed up or slow down a video by a factor, keeping the audio in sync (>1 faster, <1 slower; e.g. 2 = double speed, 0.5 = half). Range 0.25-4. Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

factor.description: Speed multiplier: >1 speeds up, <1 slows down (e.g. 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed). Range 0.25-4.
